name: Marty's Barbershop
tagline: Rustic-modern shop, a crew of talented barbers, and one philosophy: if you look good, you'll always feel good.
seoTitle: Marty's Barbershop | Barber on Nut Tree Rd, Vacaville, CA
description: Marty's Barbershop, 2611 Nut Tree Rd Ste E, Vacaville, CA. Rated 4.9 on Google and Booksy. Haircuts, fades, hot towel shaves, kids' cuts. Book online. (707) 660-8108.

about.title: Not just a cut. An experience.
body: Marty's is a rustic-modern barbershop on Nut Tree Road with a great vibe and a deep bench of barbers. The shop's philosophy: "If you look good, you will always feel good."
Owner Marty and his team have more than 1,300 reviews on Booksy at a 4.9 average. Book your barber online, or call the shop.

servicesIntro: Sample prices from MartyTheBarber's Booksy menu. Each barber sets their own menu.

services.name: Haircut
services.desc: Fades, tapers, burst fade, mohawk, comb over, and more.

services.name: Haircut & Traditional Shave
services.desc: Any haircut plus a clean razor shave with hot towel, lather and steam.

services.name: Traditional Shave
services.desc: Hot towel, steam, hot lather and straight razor.

services.name: The Full Service
services.desc: Haircut and traditional shave plus two extras (brow wax, nose wax, hot towel, shampoo or facial massage).

services.name: Haircut / Shear Work (2"+ off the top)
services.desc: Any length longer than an 8 guard, cut to the contour of the style you want.

reviews.text: Marty's barbershop is truly a special place. The atmosphere and customer service is top notch, not to mention Marty is a great person. The best barbershop in Vacaville without a doubt.
reviews.author: Google review

reviews.text: Great people, amazing skills and overall amazing experience. It didn’t feel like going in to just get a cut. I got an experience.
reviews.author: Google review

reviews.text: Best barber shop ever(and I’ve been to a lot)! Viviana kills it every time, even my wife and daughter get their cuts by her. Great environment with even better barbers.
reviews.author: Google review

reviews.text: 10/10 recommend this shop! Marty cuts my sons hair an always is quick, smooth and always makes my sons experience exceptional.
reviews.author: Google review

reviews.text: Marty is highly skilled, consistent and provides great hospitality. My Barber, Foofades is also outstanding, with great attention to detail and overall an amazing guy to talk to.
